description: AT Protocol: email a one-time code that lets this PDS sign a PLC operation with the rotation key it holds for the account.

main.description: Request an email with a code to confirm an identity change (account migration). Only for accounts whose rotation key this PDS holds in custody.

errors.name: NotCustodial
errors.description: This PDS holds no rotation key for the account (pseudonym or external account).

errors.name: NoEmail
errors.description: The account has no email address.

errors.name: EmailDeliveryFailed
errors.description: The code could not be sent.
